videos.title: GTA 6 House Was Hidden in a 2021 Rockstar Game 🏠 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
A framed house photo in the 2021 San Andreas remaster matches a house fans found in Belville, Leonida on launch day — and its garage is covered in notes from someone who thinks he's trapped in a video game. Rockstar hasn't said whether it was planned.

Sources: Kotaku, Dexerto, games.gg, TBreak

videos.title: GTA 6 Has a Jet Ski Dog That Saves You at Sea 🐶 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
Players call him Cool Dog: a goggles-wearing, life-jacketed pup on a jet ski who rescues players stranded at sea. Fans link him to Loosy, Fort Lauderdale's viral jet-skiing golden retriever (Axios, Nov 20) — Rockstar hasn't confirmed the inspiration.

Sources: Axios Fort Lauderdale, KeenGamer

videos.title: GTA 6 Crashing on PS5? Watch This First ⚠️ #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
PS5 players report GTA 6 crashing to the home screen with error CE-108255-1. As of Nov 22, Rockstar hasn't posted patch notes or a known-issues list, and the viral Nov 25 patch date is unconfirmed; Sony's advice is to update the game and system software.

Sources: Notebookcheck, UNILAD Tech, DualShockers
